title: Dripping for Jesus: Experiencing Overflow in Your Life
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he encourages you to walk in the overflow of God's presence, dripping Jesus in every moment and opportunity. This powerful message is all about being saturated with God's Spirit and allowing that to overflow into the lives of those around you, creating a difference in the world and drawing people to Christ. Get ready to be inspired and empowered to live a life that reflects the love and presence of Jesus.
